name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 22 - Am 75
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 22 e. Recalls that the Commission needs to take further timely action to increase the EU’s own resources; underlines that in line with the legally binding Interinstitutional Agreement of 16 December 2020, the Commission should present a genuine tax on financial transactions which could raise more than EUR 50 billion per year, based on the details of the financial transaction tax which should have been implemented under enhanced cooperation according to the 2013 agreement;
